function.name: yuvomi_mcp__get_menu_planning_context
function.description: REQUIRED FIRST STEP for any concrete Yuvomi menu plan, including natural requests such as plan this/next week. Load actual family profiles, rules, attendance and exact recipe IDs BEFORE asking about already configured facts or proposing meals. General recipe ideas are not a verified Yuvomi plan. For a whole-week proposal without saving use action=suggest_period; create_period permits later saving, replace_day targets one explicit change, suggest_day is read-only. Whole-period planning needs a deliberately separate conversation. A loaded context is NOT a validated plan. Correct tool errors instead of repeating identical invalid calls. Use create_day for first planning of one day; replace_day only for an explicit replacement/requested recipe.

action.description: create_period: whole period with saving; suggest_period: preview only. create_day: fill one free day, preserve occupied slots. replace_day: explicitly requested day change, may replace occupied slot. suggest_day: preview only. All day actions require date.

period.description: current/next configured period. Mutually exclusive with start_date and date. For next week send only period=next, never also start_date.

start_date.description: Exact configured period start YYYY-MM-DD. Alternative to period; never combine with period or date.

date.description: Exact day for suggest_day/replace_day. Never combine with period or start_date.

requested_recipe.description: Exact user-named recipe title/variant, if any; bind context to one unambiguous recipe.

overrides.description: Explicit user changes for THIS period only. Use stable profile_id, never guess who I means. Omitted fields retain facts.

cook.description: Family profile mapped to a real Yuvomi member, or null.

recipe_id.description: Explicit user-requested recipe; overrides taste/time/repetition only.

additional_portions.description: Explicit EXTRA servings for this person/date, added by backend. Do not combine with absolute portion.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__save_menu_plan
function.description: Validate or save cooking days from a real context_id. Normally send only date and exact recipe_id per cooking day. Backend derives fresh and take-away portions, total ingredients and source notes; NEVER create separate reheat calendar entries. If several sources fit, select via reheat_sources. validate_only=true returns a checked preview without writes. Suggestion contexts cannot write. Explicit planning/change requests need no extra confirmation. Preserve occupied slots; never retry uncertain/partial writes blindly. No shopping transfer.

kind.description: Optional; defaults cook. rest/emergency use configured recipes. Only actual cooking days are stored.

assignments.description: All free cooking days with fresh eaters together. No assignment for take-away-only days. Exact IDs, names/variants unchanged.

validate_only.description: true: validate and compute preview only, no Yuvomi writes or journal entries. false/default: existing save behavior. Use true for do not save yet.

reheat_sources.description: Only for ambiguous sources: target date, profile_id, source_date. No amounts. Existing allocations cannot silently be moved.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__get_menu_plan
function.description: Read saved meals, not full planning context. Default response is today/tomorrow within the requested period; full plan only on explicit request. No planning or shopping writes by HA; Yuvomi may materialize recurring entries on read. prepared_meals shows take-away portions with their source, without separate calendar entries.

date.description: Use at most one of date, period, start_date; never combine them.

period.description: Use at most one of date, period, start_date; never combine them.

start_date.description: Use at most one of date, period, start_date; never combine them.
